defeated_student_causes.why_failed: The implementation terminates with a runtime error while processing the graph or constructing the solution.

It reduces the candidate solution to one bipartition side or otherwise reasons from partition sizes, despite the statement explicitly allowing mixed-side independent sets and warning that the optimum can exceed either side's size.
It similarly relies on bipartition-side sizes rather than computing the maximum independent set of the full bipartite graph, so it misses instances where a mixed-side independent set is necessary.

recommended_edit: No semantics-preserving edit is available. Any edit that removes or weakens the bipartite guarantee would defeat the survivor but would also change the core problem from a tractable bipartite problem to general independent set.
